personal_workstation_root_scan.method: Recursive text scan for the local workstation user-profile root in raw and JSON-escaped forms (up to 32 escape levels); UTF-8 and UTF-16 text.

historical_execution_hashes: Original execution-time hashes are retained in their source records; public sanitized derivatives are mapped by prior Git blob SHA-256 and public-copy SHA-256 in the redaction log. No scientific result or report body was redacted.
note: Benzocaine final DOCX/PDF were read-only inputs to regression validation and remain byte-identical to the previously recorded release.
